title: Comprehensive embedding evaluation framework with tiered gold sets and drift alarms
creator: Elena Torres
description:
Goal: Build a reusable evaluation framework that measures embedding accuracy and stability across model variants, quantization profiles, and runtime conditions. The framework will support 'tiered' gold sets (core/gold, extended, and customer-cohorts), offline metrics (nDCG@k, MRR, recall@k, pairwise accuracy, calibration of cosine distances), and automated drift detection with actionable alerts. This ticket covers design, ingestion pipeline, nightly offline jobs, dashboarding, and initial alert thresholds.

Key decisions:
- Gold sets will be stored as versioned artifacts in S3 with a manifest that includes provenance, labeling schema, and acceptance thresholds.
- Evaluation suite will be a lightweight Python package (redwood-embed-eval) and a Rust-based microservice to run vectorized scoring at scale for stress tests.
- Drift detection: two-pronged approach: distributional checks (PSI, KS-test on cosine sims) and utility checks (drop in nDCG@10 or recall@50).
- Alerts: Grafana + PagerDuty for high-severity regressions, Slack channel for low-severity trends.

Out of scope: online A/B experiment wiring and reranker model retraining pipeline (separate follow-ups).
acceptance_criteria: Tiered gold set schema defined and documented (core, extended, cohort) and sample manifests uploaded to S3
redwood-embed-eval package can compute nDCG@k, MRR, recall@k, pairwise accuracy, and distance calibration reports against a gold set
Nightly offline job runs across latest model build and previous baseline and writes metrics to Influx/Grafana
Drift monitors implemented: PSI for distribution drift, rolling KS for cosine similarity, and automated regression detection on nDCG with configurable thresholds
Dashboards with historical trends and a drill-down for cohort-level failures
PagerDuty alerts trigger when regression >5% absolute on nDCG@10 for core gold set or when PSI >0.2 for core distributions
README and runbook for triage steps and how to add new gold sets or cohorts
